unit: Unit 6: International Current Affairs — Nobel Peace Prize 2025
question: Which statement about the 2025 Nobel Peace Prize is correct?
options: The prize was jointly awarded to all five permanent members of the UN Security Council.
The prize was awarded to the World Health Organization for its exceptional work eliminating infectious pandemics worldwide.
The prize was awarded to the International Cricket Council for strengthening sports diplomacy among countries.
The prize was awarded to Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado for supporting democratic rights and advocating a peaceful democratic transition.
explanation: The 2025 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado. The Norwegian Nobel Committee cited her work promoting the democratic rights of the people of Venezuela and her struggle for a just and peaceful transition from dictatorship to democracy. The prize recognised Machado’s democratic advocacy, rather than an organisation’s work on nuclear disarmament.
subject: Current Affairs

question: Which new initiative has the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board introduced to promote winter tourism and tourism in border areas?
options: Simplifying Inner Line Permit procedures in Jadung and Nelang valleys and promoting winter tourism
Keeping the main sanctums of Badrinath and Kedarnath open to pilgrims throughout the year
Completely prohibiting overnight stays by tourists in all national parks of the state
Increasing boating fees at Tehri Lake tenfold only for foreign tourists
explanation: The source describes a plan to support border villages such as Jadung and Nelang in Uttarkashi under the Vibrant Villages Programme, simplify and digitise Inner Line Permit procedures, and promote winter tourism in places such as Auli, Munsiyari and Dayara. The intended answer is the initiative combining simplified permits and winter-tourism promotion.
subject: Uttarakhand Tourism
verificationSource: Factual review required: confirm the latest status of the Jadung/Nelang and Inner Line Permit initiatives.

question: Which advanced technology is being used by the Uttarakhand Forest Department for forest-fire prevention and early warning?
options: Building 20-foot-high permanent concrete fire-barrier walls around forests
Satellite-based near-real-time fire alerts using Forest Survey of India (FSI) and National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) data, with SMS warnings
Burning all dry leaves in forests completely by applying chemical solutions
Completely prohibiting forest-panchayat access outside the monsoon season
explanation: The Forest Survey of India’s Forest Fire Alerts System uses satellite-derived hotspot data to issue near-real-time warnings. Data are processed with support from the National Remote Sensing Centre, and SMS alerts can be sent to registered users. The source’s intended answer is the satellite-based alert and SMS system; continuous drone monitoring is not required to establish that answer.
subject: Uttarakhand Environment
verificationSource: Forest Survey of India and NRSC forest-fire alert system information.

unit: Unit 6: National Current Affairs — Digital Public Infrastructure (2025–26)
question:
Consider the following components of India’s digital public infrastructure (DPI):

1. Aadhaar — a biometric-based digital identity system
2. UPI — a real-time instant-payment system
3. DigiLocker — a secure, cloud-based document storage and verification system

Which of the above are considered foundational components of India Stack?
options: Only 2 and 3; Aadhaar is merely an identity card
Only 1 and 2; DigiLocker is a private service
All three components are key pillars of India Stack
Only 1 and 3; UPI is only a network for banks
explanation: India Stack is commonly described through digital identity, payments and data/document-sharing layers. Aadhaar provides digital identity, UPI supports instant payments, and DigiLocker enables digital storage and verification of documents. Account Aggregator frameworks also form part of India’s wider digital public infrastructure. The intended answer is that all three listed components are included.
subject: Science and Technology
verificationSource: Factual review required: ‘India Stack’ does not have one universally fixed list of pillars; clarify the framework being used.

question: Which innovative service was successfully tested by AIIMS Rishikesh to supply medicines to remote mountainous areas of Uttarakhand?
options: Providing telephone consultations only and instructing patients to buy medicines from nearby shops
A helicopter ambulance service mandatorily stationed at every Gram Panchayat
A mandatory system of sending special GPS-enabled air-conditioned medicine boxes on horses and mules
A drone delivery service tested to transport anti-tuberculosis medicines from AIIMS Rishikesh to Tehri District Hospital
explanation: The source reports that in February 2023 a drone successfully delivered about 2 kg of anti-tuberculosis medicines from AIIMS Rishikesh to Tehri District Hospital over an aerial distance of roughly 36–40 km. The trial demonstrated the potential of drone delivery for remote areas; it does not by itself establish a permanent drone corridor to every mountain primary health centre.
subject: Health and Technology
verificationSource: Factual review required: verify the date, distance, payload and participating institutions against the original AIIMS Rishikesh report.

question: Which statement about the Kalvari-class submarines inducted into the Indian Navy under Project 75 is correct?
options: They are diesel-electric attack submarines built in India by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders.
They are exclusively nuclear-powered intercontinental ballistic missile submarines.
All of them were imported fully assembled from Russia.
They can operate only on the surface and cannot dive into deep water.
explanation: Under Project 75, six Scorpène/Kalvari-class submarines—Kalvari, Khanderi, Karanj, Vela, Vagir and Vagsheer—were built in India by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited in Mumbai with French collaboration. They are diesel-electric attack submarines, not nuclear-powered ballistic-missile submarines.
subject: Defence
verificationSource: Indian Navy and Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders official information.

question: Which crops are prominently included in the Uttarakhand Millet Mission, which promotes millets or ‘Shri Anna’?
options: Only hybrid maize and basmati rice grown in the Tarai region
Traditional, nutritious and climate-resilient crops such as mandua (finger millet), jhangora (barnyard millet) and amaranth
Only soybean and sunflower, used for extracting edible oil
Only sugarcane and sugar beet, supplied to sugar mills
explanation: The Uttarakhand Millet Mission promotes traditional millets such as mandua (ragi/koda), jhangora, amaranth (ramdana) and kauni. The source mentions support through measures such as procurement incentives, school meals and public distribution. Therefore, the second option best describes the crops targeted by the mission.
subject: Uttarakhand Agriculture
verificationSource: Factual review required: verify the current crop list and the mission’s support measures in state guidelines.

question: In which city was the 2025 United Nations climate conference, COP30, held?
options: Sharm el-Sheikh, Egypt
Baku, Azerbaijan
Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Belém, Brazil
explanation: COP30 was held in Belém, Brazil, from 10 to 21 November 2025. Discussions included climate finance, emissions reductions, adaptation and forest protection. The venue should be distinguished from COP29 in Baku and COP27 in Sharm el-Sheikh.
subject: Current Affairs

question: Which statement is correct about the implementation of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 in Uttarakhand?
options: The policy completely abolished Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations.
Uttarakhand rejected the policy entirely and reinstated its old examination system.
The policy was implemented only in English-medium private schools in the state.
Uttarakhand became the first state in India to launch Balvatika at the primary level as part of implementing NEP 2020.
explanation: The source states that Uttarakhand launched Balvatika, a pre-primary initiative, in July 2022 and became the first state to implement NEP 2020 at the primary level. It also describes the state as among the first to implement the policy in higher education. The exact ‘first state’ claim and date should be checked against official education-department records.
subject: Uttarakhand Education
verificationSource: Factual review required: verify the July 2022 date and the scope of the ‘first state’ claim.

unit: Unit 6: National Current Affairs — Election Commission Appointments
question: Under the recent legal changes governing appointments of the Chief Election Commissioner and other Election Commissioners of India, who is included in the Selection Committee?
options: The Prime Minister, the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha (or the leader of the largest opposition party), and a Union Cabinet Minister nominated by the Prime Minister
The Prime Minister, the Chief Justice of India and the Speaker of the Lok Sabha
The President, the Vice-President and the senior-most judge of the Supreme Court
The Union Home Minister, the Law and Justice Minister and the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha
explanation: Under the Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023, the Selection Committee consists of the Prime Minister as Chairperson, the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha (or the leader of the largest opposition party, where applicable), and a Union Cabinet Minister nominated by the Prime Minister.
subject: Indian Polity
verificationSource: Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners Act, 2023.

unit: Unit 6: Uttarakhand Current Affairs — Disaster Management
question:
Assertion (A): Assessing the carrying capacity of mountain settlements such as Joshimath is important for reducing disaster risk.

Reason (R): Slope stability, limited resources, drainage and pressures from construction and tourism affect the carrying capacity of mountain towns.

Select the correct code below.
options: A is false, but R is true.
Both A and R are true, but R does not correctly explain A.
A is true, but R is false.
Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A.
explanation: Carrying-capacity assessment helps establish how much pressure a mountain settlement’s land, water, drainage and infrastructure can sustain. Slope instability and pressure from construction or tourism can increase risk. Therefore, the reason directly explains why carrying-capacity assessment is important for disaster-risk reduction.
subject: Uttarakhand Disaster Management

unit: Unit 6: National Current Affairs — Semiconductor Mission
question: Under which Union Ministry does the India Semiconductor Mission operate?
options: Ministry of Defence
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare
Ministry of Coal
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
explanation: The India Semiconductor Mission operates under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). Its objective is to strengthen semiconductor design, fabrication, packaging and related supply chains in India. Projects in locations such as Dholera, Sanand and Morigaon belong to different stages of the wider effort.
subject: Science and Technology
verificationSource: MeitY and India Semiconductor Mission official information.

unit: Unit 6: Uttarakhand Current Affairs — House of Himalayas Brand
question: Which statement about the Uttarakhand Government’s ‘House of Himalayas’ brand, created to take traditional products to global markets, is correct?
options: It is a corporation that requires local Garhwali and Kumaoni films to be screened in all state cinemas.
It is an autonomous body that builds housing only for state government officers and employees.
It is a tourism company that provides hotel and homestay accommodation only to foreign visitors.
It is an umbrella brand for standardised packaging and global marketing of local agricultural, handicraft and GI-tagged products from Uttarakhand.
explanation: House of Himalayas was launched as Uttarakhand’s umbrella brand for promoting local products, including honey, rajma, millets, herbs, Aipan art and handicrafts, in national and international markets. It was launched during the state’s global investors’ summit in Dehradun.
subject: Uttarakhand Economy and Culture
verificationSource: Uttarakhand Government and House of Himalayas official information.

unit: Unit 6: Uttarakhand Art, Culture and Literature
question: Match the well-known writers associated with Uttarakhand with their award-winning works or literary achievements, and select the correct code.
explanation: Sumitranandan Pant, born in Kausani, received the first Jnanpith Award for Hindi for Chidambara (1968). Manglesh Dabral received the Sahitya Akademi Award for Ham Jo Dekhte Hain (2000), Viren Dangwal for Dushchakra Mein Srashta (2004), and Ruskin Bond for Our Trees Still Grow in Dehra (1992). The names, titles and dates should be checked against award records when finalising the matching list.
subject: Uttarakhand Culture
verificationSource: Factual review required: verify the exact award categories, titles and years, especially the Sahitya Akademi attribution for Ruskin Bond.

unit: Unit 6: Uttarakhand Current Affairs — Overall Development (2025–26)
question:
Consider the following statements about Uttarakhand’s overall development goals for 2025–26:

1. The state government had set the ‘Empowered Uttarakhand @25’ goal in advance of the state’s silver jubilee year in 2025.
2. The state has begun assessing its Gross Environmental Product (GEP) to measure ecological balance alongside development.
3. In NITI Aayog’s SDG India Index, Uttarakhand has ranked among the country’s leading-performing states.

Which of the statements above are true?
options: Only statements 2 and 3 are true; the silver jubilee will be celebrated in 2030.
Only statements 1 and 2 are true; Uttarakhand ranked among the lowest states in the SDG Index.
Only statements 1 and 3 are true; Assam was the first state to implement GEP.
All three statements are true according to Uttarakhand’s development goals.
explanation: The source states that the government had set the ‘Empowered Uttarakhand @25’ goal ahead of the state’s silver jubilee, which was marked on 9 November 2025. It also describes Uttarakhand as an early state to assess Gross Environmental Product and as a leading performer in NITI Aayog’s SDG India Index. The specific index edition and ranking should be verified.
subject: Uttarakhand Current Affairs
verificationSource: Factual review required: verify the relevant SDG India Index edition and the GEP implementation description.
